submission.natural_language_explanation: GPT-2 L2/H7 is a broad early-position head, not a content detector: its strength is set by position in the window, peaking at tokens 2-8 (up to 5.82) and decaying to near zero by about token 60, on any content. It attends mostly to the current token itself and its OV circuit suppresses the attended token (copying score -0.91). Every text of two or more tokens peaks above the 1.45 active line at its opening (2.37 for a two-token text, 4.2-4.8 for ordinary prose, code, nonsense tokens, number lists and function-word-only strings), so no short text is predicted inactive; the same words placed late in a long window read about 0.0, and the peak after token 60 of a long passage is 0.21.
